verdict.rationale: vLLM documents efficient multi-LoRA support allowing multiple adapters to be served from a single base model without restart, which partially addresses 'switching between models' at the adapter level, but there is no evidence of dynamically loading/unloading distinct base models on a running server without restart. missing for 10: documented API/CLI for hot-swapping full base models, evidence of dynamic model loading endpoint, community confirmation of multi-model serving without restart.
